title: Creation
subtitle: Genesis 1–2
description: God creates the heavens and the earth, culminating in humanity made in His image.

title: The Fall
subtitle: Genesis 3
description: Humanity's rebellion introduces sin, separation from God, and the initial promise of redemption (Gen 3:15).

title: The Great Flood
subtitle: Genesis 6–9
description: God judges human evil through the flood and re-establishes a covenant with Noah.

title: Tower of Babel
subtitle: Genesis 11
description: Human ambition leads to the scattering of nations and confusion of languages.

title: Call of Abraham
subtitle: Genesis 12
description: God covenants with Abraham, promising a land, a great nation, and blessing to all families of the earth.

title: Birth of Isaac
subtitle: Genesis 21
description: God fulfills His promise to Abraham and Sarah with the birth of Isaac, the child of the covenant.

title: Joseph Rises in Egypt
subtitle: Genesis 41
description: Pharaoh elevates Joseph to second-in-command over Egypt, positioning him to save his family from famine.

title: Slavery in Egypt
subtitle: Exodus 1
description: A new Pharaoh who did not know Joseph enslaves the Israelites, leading to centuries of hard labor and oppression.

title: The Exodus from Egypt
subtitle: Exodus 12–14
description: God rescues Israel from Egyptian slavery through Moses, parting the Red Sea.

title: Covenant at Mount Sinai
subtitle: Exodus 19–20
description: Israel receives the Law, the Ten Commandments, and instructions for the Tabernacle.

title: Fall of Jericho
subtitle: Joshua 6
description: Joshua leads Israel into the Promised Land, and the walls of Jericho collapse by God's power.

title: Deborah & Barak Defeat Sisera
subtitle: Judges 4–5
description: Deborah and Barak lead Israel to victory against the Canaanite army when God bogs down Sisera's iron chariots in the Kishon River.

title: Gideon’s 300 Victory
subtitle: Judges 6–8
description: God reduces Gideon's army to 300 men, defeating the vast Midianite host with trumpets, torches, and clay jars.

title: Story of Ruth & Boaz
subtitle: Ruth 1–4
description: Ruth's loyalty to Naomi leads her to Boaz, her kinsman-redeemer, establishing the family line for King David and the Messiah.

title: Samson & Delilah
subtitle: Judges 16
description: Samson's betrayal by Delilah leads to his capture, but his final act destroys the Philistine temple.

title: Birth of Samuel
subtitle: 1 Samuel 1
description: Hannah's prayer is answered with the birth of Samuel, who grows up to be Israel's last judge and prophet.

title: Saul Becomes King
subtitle: 1 Samuel 10
description: Samuel anoints Saul as Israel's first king after the people demand a king like the surrounding nations.

title: David Anointed King
subtitle: 1 Samuel 16
description: Samuel anoints David, establishing the royal lineage for the Messiah.

title: Dedication of Solomon's Temple
subtitle: 1 Kings 8
description: The glory of the Lord fills the newly built Temple in Jerusalem.

title: Division of the Kingdom
subtitle: 1 Kings 12
description: Israel splits into two nations: Israel in the North and Judah in the South.

title: Elijah on Mt. Carmel
subtitle: 1 Kings 18
description: Elijah confronts the 450 prophets of Baal, and God answers with fire from heaven.

title: Fall of Samaria (Northern Kingdom)
subtitle: 2 Kings 17
description: Assyria conquers Israel and deports the northern ten tribes.

title: Babylonian Exile & Destruction of Temple
subtitle: 2 Kings 25
description: Nebuchadnezzar destroys Jerusalem and the First Temple, taking Judah into captivity.

title: Return from Exile & Rebuilding
subtitle: Ezra 1–3
description: Cyrus allows the Jewish people to return to Jerusalem and lay the foundation for the Second Temple.

title: Birth of Jesus Christ
subtitle: Luke 2 / Matthew 1
description: The incarnation of the Messiah in Bethlehem.

title: Crucifixion & Resurrection
subtitle: Matthew 27–28
description: The death, burial, and resurrection of Jesus Christ, accomplishing eternal salvation.

title: Day of Pentecost
subtitle: Acts 2
description: The Holy Spirit descends upon believers, marking the birth of the Church.
